_note: The Strava cron was removed, not disabled.
Nothing in the interface starts the Strava OAuth flow — the Strava tile on Settings
routes to intervals.icu, which is the aggregator every device already reaches ARI
through. So `strava_connections` is never written, and this job iterated an empty
list at 03:30 every night while occupying one of two cron slots on the Hobby plan.
The route and its callback are left in place: they work, and they are the starting
point if a direct Strava app is ever registered.
